component.name: PatchCraft Launcher
component.summary: Unofficial Linux launcher for RuneScape and Jagex Accounts

description.p: PatchCraft Launcher is an unofficial native Linux desktop launcher for RuneScape 3, Old School RuneScape (RuneLite, HDOS, and Official client), and RuneScape: Dragonwilds with zero Wine or Proton overhead.

ul.li: Native 64-bit execution for RuneScape 3 using official Linux binaries with full hardware acceleration.
Integrated Old School RuneScape multi-client switcher supporting RuneLite, HDOS, and the official client.
One-click launch for RuneScape: Dragonwilds with live Steam RSS patch feeds.
Direct Jagex Account OAuth 2.0 PKCE authentication with built-in Cloudflare Turnstile handling.
Preserves local ~/.runelite configuration, plugins, screenshots, and bank tags.
Zero RAM mode automatically closes the launcher after game start to optimize memory.
Optional Feral GameMode (gamemoderun) and MangoHud overlay toggles.

description.p: Direct In-App & Web Issue Reporting: Added direct bug report and feedback submission with Turnstile spam protection and downloadable Markdown diagnostic bundles alongside refreshed GitHub Issue templates; Website & Visual Refresh: Updated launcher.patchcraft.dev with clean desktop screenshots, revised hero copy, improved layout spacing, and aligned Privacy Policy and licensing notices; Hardened Release Packaging: Strengthened application runtime integrity and binary packaging protections across all desktop distribution formats.

Website News & Release Feed: Added an interactive Updates & News section to the project website with JSON/RSS feeds and automated release synchronization; Live Client Logger & Diagnostics: Fixed live log line rendering, replaced silent error catches with structured diagnostics, and removed startup timer workarounds across window initialization and deep-link handling; Launcher Architecture & Modularity: Refactored UI controllers (Auto Updater, RS3/OSRS Doctor diagnostics, and Tools hub) into focused modules and consolidated process lifecycle monitoring, icon deployment, and streaming downloads; Community: Added Code of Conduct, refreshed issue/PR templates, and synced public community files.
Resolve root-cause bugs across auth, launcher, updater, diagnostics, and renderer; Dependencies: Resolve minimatch Dependabot alert, update Electron/Vite/Oxlint, and bump Flatpak runtime to 26.08.

Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (Resolute Raccoon) and 24.04 LTS legacy Jagex APT repository detection and one-click remediation, modern Debian/Ubuntu t64 library resolution in RS3 and OSRS Doctors, hardened standalone installer script, and website UI/accessibility enhancements.
Comprehensive codebase refinement, internal helper consolidation, performance and memory optimizations across diagnostics and cache tools, and distribution specification parity.

Interactive multi-source character membership detection with real-time toggle badges, Cache Size Inspector with safe clearing across RS3 NXT, RuneLite, and HDOS, in-app Issue Reporter and environment diagnostics collector, and automated CI/CD security workflows.

Comprehensive internal auto-updater overhaul with dynamic package format selection, safe atomic in-place AppImage updates, native package manager integration for RPM, Pacman, DEB, and Snap, and automated Snap Store publishing pipeline.

Package upgrade compatibility fixes declaring Replaces, Conflicts, and Provides between jagex-launcher and linux-jagex-launcher, Arch User Repository binary path and symlink fixes, and release version synchronization across all packaging formats.

HiDPI display scaling controls for OSRS (1.0x to 3.0x), multi-instance client manager with live heartbeat and stop controls, in-app live client log viewer with ANSI styling and token redaction, multi-GPU and dedicated GPU selection (DRI PRIME and NVIDIA offload), custom launch command argument tokenization fixes, deep link OAuth protocol callback completion, process verification safeguards, and harmless desktop subsystem warning classifications.

AppImage child environment isolation preventing RuneLite launch loops, improved RuneLite and OSRS process lifecycle tracking across launcher handoff, OpenJDK 24+ ZGC compatibility, static FUSE2-free AppImage runtime for Ubuntu 24.04/26.04, single-instance window focus restoration, Wayland display presentation fallbacks, official Old School RuneScape client integration modal, interactive play state unlock, and official Canonical Snap distribution pipeline with 3:1 store banners.
Hotfix resolving Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 t64 transitional package dependencies, Launchpad PPA rate-limiting cooldown and retry resiliency, and official website layout enhancements.

Native Linux system tray integration with instant character launch menus, Quick Shortcuts and Client Folders Hub (screenshots, logs, and cache for RS3, RuneLite, and HDOS), desktop shortcuts and application icon re-registration, official Launchpad Ubuntu PPA distribution, and enhanced AppStream metadata compliance.

Live World Ping Prober with visual latency badges and world hopping, Community Resources & Tools hub for RS3, OSRS, and Dragonwilds (including RuneKit and alt1-electron), Low-Spec / Older Linux Hardware fallback mode (Mesa/DRI overrides and JVM tuning), and contextual settings navigation.

Steam Deck turnkey installer with native shortcuts.vdf registration, multi-account profile switcher, Mesa Threaded OpenGL optimizations, human-readable release notes, and universal modal keyboard navigation.

Steam Deck & SteamOS handheld enhancements with full gamepad navigation, multi-account profile switching, Mesa Threaded OpenGL optimizations, automated RS3 Doctor diagnostics, and integrated auto-updater.
Initial stable release of the Linux Jagex Launcher featuring RS3 native support, RuneLite/HDOS integration, and Dragonwilds launching.
